post.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatcher for the Configuration MCP server.
post.description:
One operation in the document, with an opaque body, because that is what the route is
(T-2402): a single POST whose meaning is the JSON-RPC `method` inside it, not the path. The
alternative — leaving it out because it is not REST — made the API page and the published
contract disagree, and a route a person can call belongs in the contract whatever shape its
body has. The methods themselves are listed on the page (API/01 §21), where a JSON-RPC
surface can be written down properly.

FailedRequest.description: A request of the frame the bridge answered with an error status.

Failure.description: One result of the last run that did not pass, and the open task it filed.

edges.description: Directed edges, each naming the manifest it was read from.

nodes.description: Every object the federation touches, keyed by `kind/name`.

FieldChange.description:
A single leaf field modification in a plan diff.

Paths are dotted strings rooted at `metadata` or `spec` (e.g. `spec.audience`,
`spec.representations[1]`, `metadata.labels.joinedcontext.com/domain`).
Keys containing dots (such as reverse-DNS label names) are deliberately not escaped.

FieldConflict.description: One field both sides changed to different values since their common base (CC-80).

FileConflict.description:
One file both the workspace and main changed since the workspace's base (CC-80). `fields`
lists what a person has to choose; empty means the two sides merge on their own, which
updating from main does.

FlowRequest.description: Running a blueprint: the parameters the form collected (API/01 §13).

parameters.description: The values the user filled in, validated against `spec.parameterSchema` (CC-24).

version.description:
The version the form was generated from. A mismatch is a conflict rather than an
expansion against a schema the user never saw (CC-26).

Fonts.description:
Heading and body font stacks. Self-hosted or system families only: nothing on a page
fetches from a third-party origin at runtime.

FormContextRequest.description: The form the question was asked from, as the browser sends it (API/04 §"Start or Continue").

Freshness.description: How recent the data of one pipeline is.

type.description: The pipeline's output type; empty when it names none and the whole space counts.

Front.description:
How a request authenticated: what `GET /api/v1/auth/me` reports so the UI knows whose
logout to call (ADR-N-019 §3.4).

source.description: LinkML YAML, exactly as the editor holds it.

Grant.description: One rule in force, with the binding and role it came through, so a refusal can be traced.

scope.description:
Where the binding that carries this rule applies: `organization`, `project:{name}` or
`contextSpace:{name}`. A grant read here may have been inherited from the organization,
and the page says so rather than making it look local (PF-60, PF-61).

space.description:
Set when the binding is scoped to one context space: the rule then applies only to a
manifest whose `spec.contextSpaceRef` names it.

Identity.description: Who is signed in. Returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and used by every protected route.

groups.description:
Keycloak group paths from the token's `groups` claim, without the leading `/`. Identity,
not permission: a `RoleBinding` names a group, the Portal checks the binding (PF-50).

roles.description:
Keycloak realm roles from the ID token's `realm_access.roles` (CC-42). Empty when the
token asserts none. Display and enablement only — the resource API and the forge enforce
the same boundaries independently.

subject.description: Keycloak `sub`: stable, opaque, the only durable user key.

ImportOptions.description: The options an import wizard sends beside the file (Architecture/06 §6).

manifests.description: The manifests themselves, for a caller that posts JSON rather than a file.

orgDomain.description:
The organisation domain every imported id is rewritten to; this instance's own
organisation when absent (PF-10, PF-43).

spaceMapping.description:
Spaces the bundle names that are not copied: each reference to `from` lands on the
target project's space `to`, ids included (T-1441, MF-26).

targetNamespace.description: The namespace every imported manifest is rewritten into; the project when absent (MF-22).

url.description: A bundle to fetch rather than upload. Refused for now, see [`import`].

ImportReport.description: What one import would do, answered on a dry run and echoed in the merge request body.

lane.description: The lane the whole bundle lands in: the riskiest of everything it carries (CC-63).

nativeFiles.description: Files carried through untouched: `bento.yaml`, LinkML sources, schema artifacts.

needs.description:
What the bundle cannot carry and has to be provided where it lands (CC-84): secret
values, people, hosts, feed credentials. Empty means nothing is to be provided. Never a
secret value, only where one is set.

reassigned.description:
Policies whose `assigner` the import rewrote to `did:web:{orgDomain}`, as `Policy/{name}`
to the DID the bundle carried: the grant is this organisation's now (CC-82, R6).

renamed.description: Resources imported under a new name, `old -> new` (`rename`).

replaced.description: Resources that would replace one the project already has.

skipped.description: Resources left alone because the project already has them (`skip`).

source.description: Where the bundle came from, when it carried a `kind: Bundle` index (MF-20).

verified.description:
Per file, whether what the import wrote equals the checksum the bundle index carries,
with the namespace mapping undone (MF-42). Empty when the bundle carries no checksums:
an unverifiable transfer says so rather than claiming every file is equal.

ImportSdmRequest.description: A model to import from the Smart Data Models catalogue.

model.description:
Catalogue identifier, `dataModel.Environment/AirQualityObserved`. Never a URL: the
allowlist that limits fetching to the Smart Data Models organisation lives in Model
Tools (DM-10), and the Portal refuses anything a caller could steer.

InstanceSummary.description: One `CkanInstance`, without anything secret about it.

apiTokenRef.description: The name of the secret holding the API token. Never its value (EP-67).

organizationDefault.description: The organization a dataset lands in when the endpoint names none.

KeyClaim.description:
A key asked for over MCP, waiting for its person in the Portal (PF-104). It carries no token
and no id of a key that does not exist yet: nothing is minted until the person confirms it.

keyExpiresAt.description: The expiry the minted key will carry, when it has one.

overlapHours.description: How long the replaced key keeps working beside its successor.

KeyInfo.description:
One key as everyone else ever sees it: what an operator decides on, and nothing that opens
a door.

Languages.description: The locale the UI starts in and the ones it offers.

default.description: The locale a first-time visitor gets.

offered.description: Every locale the switcher lists; always contains the default.

LogoutTarget.description: The URL the browser must visit to finish an RP-initiated logout at Keycloak.

endSessionUrl.description:
Absolute URL: Keycloak's `end_session_endpoint`, or the portal itself when no realm is
configured.

front.description:
`portal` for the Portal's own cookie session, `edge` for the APISIX `openid-connect`
session, `bearer` for a token a service sent (ADR-N-019).

Me.description: Who is signed in and through which front, so the UI knows whose logout to call.

MessageRequest.description: What a person says to a run that is already going (AG-45).

oneOf.description: On a conversation: the capabilities from this message on (AG-92, T-2718).

endpointNames.description: On a conversation: the endpoints the assistant may query from this message on (AG-75).

oneOf.description: On a conversation: the page the person is on as they send it (T-2763).

Method.description: Which of the two proofs verified the domain.

credential.description: Name of the `api-key` credential in the manifest this key belongs to.

expiresAt.description: Overrides the credential's own expiry; absent means the manifest's, or never.

MintedKey.description: A minted key. The only place a raw token ever appears (PF-36).

ModelChange.description: Single detected difference between the published model and the candidate LinkML source.

Need.description: One thing a copy cannot carry (CC-84, API/01 §10).

link.description: The Portal page that sets it.

where.description: The manifest and the path inside it, `Kind/name spec.path`.

why.description: Why it has to be provided, in words.

id.description: `kind/name`, stable across runs so a selection survives a refresh.

kind.description: Manifest kind, or `ExternalSource` for a source outside this platform.

name.description: Manifest name. For an external source, the name of the registration that reaches it.

phase.description:
The lifecycle phase the object last reported, for the card's status chip (UI-25, UI-28).
Absent for an external source and for an object that has reported nothing.

oneOf.description: For a `ContextSourceRegistration`, what the card may say about it. Never a credential.

title.description:
The object's title as the manifest carries it, one entry per language. Absent when the
manifest has none: the UI falls back to the name rather than the Portal inventing one.

NodeCounters.description:
Folds every series of one stream into the counters the view shows. Series of the same family
are summed (a stream may have several inputs or outputs); the latency takes the slowest
output rather than a sum, which would mean nothing.
The runner registers each stream under the pipeline's own name, so the pipeline name is
also the `stream` label to select on.
What one component of a stream counted, as its own label reports it (T-1125).

ObjectMeta.title: ObjectMeta
ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.
A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.
A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

ObservedPage.description: One page of the application as the frame rendered it.

rows.description: The row counts of its tables.

OpenProject.description: What a person fills in to open a project.

name.description: The slug: the `{project}` segment of every path of it (PF-67).

OpenRequest.description: What opening a workspace asks for (API/01 §22).

oneOf.description: The whole project when absent.

ttlDays.description: Seven when absent, at most fourteen.

OperationAccess.description: One operation of the registry as a run the caller starts would meet it (AG-70, UI-56).

person.description: The caller's own permission in the project (PF-50).

profile.description: The profile's half: its access block, or the read-only default without one.

reason.description: The half that refuses; `null` when neither does.

OrganizationModel.description: One `DataModel` of the organization as the pickers list it (DM-63).

catalogueUnavailable.description: Why no catalogue entries could be listed, when Model Tools did not answer.

PageContextRequest.description: The page the question was asked from, as the browser sends it: the route only.

PartialSuccess.description: What the collector reads: how many records the Portal refused, and why the first one was.

PauseRequest.description: Whether syncing is on or off.

paused.description: `true` switches the loop off, `false` switches it back on.

Person.description: A person as the Portal shows one (API/01 §24).

createdAt.description: When the realm created the person (RFC 3339).

lastSeen.description: The last access of the person's newest open session; `null` when none is open.

pendingDeletion.description: The Change a deletion waits for; `null` when none is pending.

next.description: `first` of the following page, when there is one.

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource deployment is in progress.
Resource is live and active in cluster.
Reconciliation error.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

PipelineLogLine.description: One line of a run's log.

at.description: When the Portal took the line, RFC 3339.

id.description: Its place in the log; the `before` of the next page.

message.description: What happened, in words; empty for a record that was sent.

recordId.description: The record's `id`, as the mapping produced it; empty when it had none.

step.description: The step of `spec.steps` it failed at, when it failed in a step.

PipelineLogPage.description: One page of a run's log.

next.description: The `before` of the next page, when there is one.

nodes.description:
The same counters per component of the stream, by the Bento `label` the reconciler
wrote (T-1125): the studio paints a node with the numbers of its own label. Empty for a
stream deployed before the labels, whose samples carry none.

received.description:
Cumulative since the runner started, exactly as it reports them: a rate is the view's
job, history is Prometheus' job (OPS-16). An absent field is not zero, it is a counter
this runner does not export.

rejected.description:
Records the validation stage refused since the runner started (PL-61): counted apart
from `errors`, because a refused record is the stage working, not the stream failing.

scrapedAt.description: When the Portal read the runner, RFC 3339. The counters are as old as this instant.

firstAt.description: The first and the last line the Portal took for it, RFC 3339.

run.description: Its name: the tick's time, or the UTC hour of a source that never ends.

PipelineRunList.description: A pipeline's latest runs with their counts (PL-62).

items.description: The run with the latest line first, at most 200.

PipelineTestSample.description:
The sample of one test as the route reads it and the OpenAPI document publishes it (UI-07).
jcctl's `Sample` carries no schema; this is its shape, turned into it by `From` below, so a
field jcctl gains or loses fails to compile here instead of drifting from the document.

format.description: How the sample is split into messages.

text.description: The sample inline, at most five mebibytes.

url.description: An http(s) URL the runner fetches the sample from instead.

PipelineTestSampleFormat.description: How a sample is split: one message, a CSV row each, or a JSON array's elements.

PlanDiff.description: Summary and field-level changes between two resource revisions.

PlatformRole.description: A platform role the person holds, and the binding and the way it reaches them (PF-94).

Point.description: One earlier run, for the trend.

advancedMode.description:
Whether manifest forms show the fields a `UiSchema` marks `advanced` (CC-29, UI-02).

Absent means off, so a person who has never chosen gets the view CC-29 asks for. It is a
display preference: it changes what a form shows, never what a write may do.

dashboardLayouts.description: Free JSON per dashboard name, the browser's own saved state.

defaultProject.description: The project the shell opens on.

Preset.description: What the assistant may do in the conversation, in three steps.

Preview.description: A workspace's preview as a person, an agent or an MCP client reads it.

endpoints.description: The Endpoints of the workspace's project in the preview; empty unless it runs.

pausedPipelines.description: Every pipeline of the project, paused until a person starts it (PL-40).

reason.description: Why the loader refused the render, when it did (CC-78).

PreviewEndpoint.description: One Endpoint of a preview and where it answers.

name.description: The Endpoint's name, as in the workspace.

originSlug.description:
The slug `main` serves the same Endpoint on, the source of a copy; absent for an
Endpoint the workspace adds.

slug.description: The slug minted for the preview; never the origin's.

PreviewErrorRequest.description: A runtime error the preview frame posted as `jc-error`, relayed by the page that frames it.

PreviewObservationRequest.description:
What the preview frame saw of one version, page by page, relayed by the page that frames it
(SDK-27). Every field is text the frame wrote.

version.description: The `v` of the preview URL the frame loaded.

Probe.description: One fetch of a DataSource on the project's runner, or why there was none (MF-39).

records.description: Messages after the format split; one for a JSON document, one per element of an array.

skipped.description: Why the source was not fetched: a credential, no runner, a feed that did not answer.

errors.description:
Every violation of one request, when there is more than one thing to say. A form marks
all its bad fields from this in one pass instead of one round trip per mistake (CC-24).

ProfileAccess.description: An `AgentProfile` and what it lets a run of the caller do.

access.description: `spec.access` as written; `null` when the profile has none.

ProjectAffordances.description: What the organization's own settings let this caller do with projects (PF-65).

creation.description: Whether `POST /api/v1/projects` would open a project for this caller.

ProjectDetail.description: One project as the Portal holds it, with what it is using of its quota (PF-75).

ProjectList.description:
The projects the configuration repository holds (PF-05): one per `projects/<slug>/`
directory the mirror has a manifest from.

usage.description:
Every countable dimension by its manifest field name (`contextSpaces`,
`residentPipelines`, `publicEndpoints`, `apps`).

name.description: The project slug, the `{project}` segment of every other path.

PublicationStatus.description: What one endpoint publishes, and where.

datasetUrl.description: Where the dataset is in the catalogue, once it is published.

oneOf.description: The row mirror, when the endpoint asks for one (EP-65).

endpoint.description: The endpoint that declares the publication.

instanceMissing.description: `true` when that instance is missing from the project, which is why nothing publishes.

organization.description: The CKAN organization the dataset lands in.

phase.description: The endpoint's lifecycle phase, as the mirror reports it.

resources.description: One resource per enabled representation, plus the schema index (EP-64).

PutDraftRequest.description: Input payload for saving or updating a draft manifest.

Readiness.description: Whether this replica serves the repository yet: `ready` or `loading`, nothing more (OPS-51).

Rebuild.description: Whether Rebuild is offered, and why not when it is not (PF-50, UI-44).

RegistrationCard.description: What a registration's card shows (UI-27, PF-48).

external.description: Whether the source is on this platform or outside it.

types.description: The entity types the source is claimed to hold.

Rejected.description: One record the runner did not write.

at.description: When the runner refused it, RFC 3339.

id.description: Its place in the list, which "Retry after fix" names.

path.description: The attribute the constraint is about.

record.description: The record as the mapping produced it, secrets masked.

rule.description: The constraint it broke (a SHACL component, `type` or `id`, PL-59).

step.description:
The step of `spec.steps` the record failed at, when it failed in a step and not in the
validation stage.

RejectedPage.description: One page of a pipeline's rejected records.

next.description: The `before` of the next page, when there is one.

total.description: How many the pipeline holds, at most 1000 (PL-61).

RelayedEvent.description: What the proxy relays on behalf of a workspace it has already authenticated.

Resolution.description: The side a person kept for one conflicting field of one file (CC-80).

field.description: The field's path, as the conflict lists it; empty for the whole file.

path.description: The file's path in the repository, as the comparison lists it.

spec.description:
Free-form JSON whose shape the kind decides: an open map in the OpenAPI document, so a
generated client can send a real spec without a cast (T-1488).

oneOf.description: Never read from Git, always computed by the Portal API (MF-04).

ResourceLink.description: One CKAN resource of a dataset.

name.description: What the resource is called in CKAN.

url.description: The URL a citizen clicks, always under the endpoint (EP-66).

oneOf.description: The draft this proposal is made from; the proposal then takes the draft's own manifest.

files.description:
Files beside the manifest, by path relative to its folder, each a text: at most 16 and
256 KiB together.

ResourceProposal.description:
What a proposal of one resource sends: the manifest, and beside it the draft the form holds
(AG-61) and the files the manifest names but cannot contain (DM-39). Both are taken out of the
body before it is read as an envelope; the type is what the OpenAPI document says, so the
generated client sends them without a cast (T-1488).

RetryAnswer.description: What a replay sent to the runner, and what it could not send.

masked.description:
Records left on the list because a value of theirs was masked when they were kept:
replaying the mask would write it. The pipeline's next read of its source brings them.

replayed.description:
Records replayed through the pipeline's current stage and write; one that still breaks
the model comes back to the list with its rule.

overlapHours.description: How long the rotated key keeps working beside its successor, in hours (PF-38).

RuleCount.description: One failing rule of a space: a SHACL component and the path it is about.

examples.description: At most five ids of entities that break it.

RunContext.description:
Everything the proxy needs to decide one request, and nothing a workspace may see.

This is the one place the ticket hash leaves the Portal, and it leaves on the internal
listener alone. The budgets are read from the profile at answer time rather than copied into
the run row, so lowering a profile's ceiling takes effect on the runs already in flight.

endpointSlugs.description:
Every endpoint slug of the run, the primary first: what `/v1/data/endpoints/{slug}/…`
may address (Architecture/19 §4).

maxEgressBytesPerRun.description:
The profile's `egress.maxBytesPerRun`: what the run may read from the allow-listed hosts
in total, counted by the proxy's fetch route. Zero for a profile that names no host, and
a run with zero reaches nothing (AG-50, AG-65).

pathPrefix.description: The folder the run writes, as its repository spells it.

reasoningEffort.description: The profile's `model.reasoningEffort`: the proxy adds it to every model call (AG-72).

repository.description:
The project's own repository in layout 2, the one repository the proxy's forge route
reaches for this run (CC-87, AG-86); absent, the configuration repository.

stepsPerRun.description:
The profile's `limits.stepsPerRun`: the proxy counts one model call per step and refuses
the call past it, so a run stops at the limit however its driver loops (AG-25, AG-51).

RunList.description: One page of runs, newest first.

Scope.description:
What a workspace covers (CC-76, API/01 §22): the whole project, one space and what it
holds, or a list of resources.

SetupItem.description: One step or operator item and whether it is done.

Side.description: Which side a person kept for one conflicting field (CC-80).

SpaceMapping.description: One space of the origin mapped onto a space of the target project (T-1441).

SpaceQuality.description: What one run found in one space.

StartConversation.description: Request payload for starting or continuing an assistant conversation.

oneOf.description: The capabilities the person chose (AG-92, T-2718): they only narrow.

endpointNames.description: The endpoints the person chose, zero to five, which the assistant may query (AG-75).

oneOf.description:
Where the person is standing when they ask (UI-61, AG-77): the form that is open, the draft
it edits and the field they were last in. Values never travel here; the assistant reads the
person's own draft with `jc_draft_get` under their own grants.

The page the person is on (T-2763, API/04 §"Start or Continue"): its route, read against
the Portal's page table, names only.
One path, as the request and the `path` event spell it.

path.description: The path the person picked in the empty assistant (AG-87, ADR-N-032).

Status.description:
The status the Portal API reports (MF-04). It is `jc_core::Status` plus `sourceUrl` and a phase
that is always known; it stays a Portal type until jc-core carries `sourceUrl` too (docs API/01
section 6 is the contract), then it becomes a re-export like its neighbours.

build.description:
What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named
(AP-13a). The one member of `status` a proposal may carry, and only from the role whose
`propose` on `App` is constrained to it (AP-73).

oneOf.description:
Whether an Organization owns the domain it declares (PF-41): computed by the reconciler,
never read from Git, and only ever on an Organization.

sourceUrl.description:
Forge page of the file this manifest was read from, so a view can link "Source"
without knowing where a kind lives in the repository. Computed, never read from Git.

SyncRunReport.description: What one run did, and where the source stands afterwards.

flags.description: What the run could not do, in sentences a person can act on.

proposed.description: The `kind: Change` envelope of every merge request the run opened.

unchanged.description: Whether the run changed anything at all.

SyncSourceStatus.description: What the project page shows for one source (MF-30).

durable.description:
Whether a restart keeps this. `false` on a Portal without a database, where a restart
costs one duplicate proposal per source with a run in flight.

lastError.description: Why the last run did not finish, when it did not.

lastRunAt.description: When the last run happened, in seconds since the epoch.

mergeRequest.description: The merge request a run opened and nobody has answered yet.

observedRevision.description: The source revision the repository carries.

SyncStatus.description:
Status of the background Git mirror synchronization.

Served to the browser, so it deliberately never carries a token,
repository URL, or branch name.

leader.description:
Whether this replica is the one that reconciles (CC-03). A Portal without a database
has no election to run and reconciles on its own, so it reports itself as the leader.

sample.description: What the harness reads, read through `SampleRequest`, whose shape the document publishes.

merged.description: Files both changed, merged field by field and checked again.

taken.description: Files main changed that the workspace had not touched, now as main has them.

UpdateRequest.description: What updating a workspace from main asks for: the answer to every conflict (CC-80).

Usage.description: One quota dimension of a project: what it holds and what it may (PF-75).

limit.description: Absent when no quota limits this dimension.

waitsOn.description:
The open changes whose resources this manifest names (MF-48): it resolves once they are
approved, and its own change cannot merge before them. Empty for every other verdict.

Verified.description: One file of a bundle as the import verified it (MF-42).

path.description: The path the bundle index gave the file.

WorkflowRun.description: A workflow run of an application's repository, as the App page links it (AP-86, AP-103).

status.description: `queued`, `in_progress`, `waiting` or `completed`, as the forge says it.

url.description: The run's page, behind the forge's sign-in (PF-81).

changes.description: How many files it changes; read only when one workspace is asked for.

WorkspaceView.description: A workspace as the API answers it.
